description: Free. Estimate the maximum model, compute and platform credits for a paid tool. Optional: paid tools can be called directly. Use it when the user asks what a job will cost. With cost_mode "agent_authored" and a specification, it also validates the specification with exactly the checks the paid tool runs and lists every problem as a blocker, so fix those before paying. No model calls or paid workload execution.

analysis.description: For generate_safety_analysis: fha, fmea, both (default) or stpa. stpa needs no standard.

max_depth.description: Only for run_agent_swarm: levels of division, 1 to 3 (default 2). At 2 and 3, a subsystem the orchestrator judges too large for one agent is divided again inside its frozen boundary.

model_id.description: A model from a generation job (model_ id) or a saved studio model (m_ id); a saved model is read at the head of main.

rows.description: Only for cost_mode "agent_authored" on generate_safety_analysis: {conditions:[{target,description,severity,...}],modes:[{target,mode,severity,occurrence,detection,...}]}; with analysis "stpa": {losses:[{id,description}],hazards:[{id,description,losses}],controllers:[{target,processModel}],controlActions:[{from,to,name,ucas:[{id,type,context,contextVariables,hazards,constraint}|{type,notApplicable,rationale}]}],feedback:[{from,to,name,updates}],constraints:[{id,name,text}]}.

specification.description: Required for cost_mode "agent_authored" on generate_system_model and build_full_system: the system you wrote, as JSON matching this schema (the same schema describe_mbestudio returns as specification_schema). estimate_cost validates it for free with the same checks the paid tools run and lists every problem as a blocker, so call it before a paid tool.

placement.description: Optional placement hint in the system frame (x forward, y left, z up). side names the faces of the largest shell (or frame) the component sits against; a wheel takes a corner, for example ["front","left"]. Omitted: read from side words in the id, else laid out by its interfaces.

role.description: Optional physical form, drawn from size_m: shell (a body or hull the other components sit in, hollow), frame, wheel (rolls on the ground; placed at a corner of the shell with its thinnest size_m across), disc, rotor (bladed), shaft, tube, vessel, machine (motor, pump), housing, electronics, panel, aerofoil, seat, sensor, lamp, glazing, other. Omitted: read from the id and description.

specification.title: MBEstudio agent-authored system specification

subsystem.description: For reprompt_agent: qualified name of the subsystem, e.g. "Rover::DriveUnit". For run_agent_swarm on a saved model: the subsystem to decompose one level further (its parts get the agents); leave it out to work on the whole system's subsystems.

name: estimate_cost
title: Estimate job cost
